hazard: Departure of patients without clear follow-up arrangements

concerns.quote: the outcome of decisions taken by the consultant on the ward round on 15 October 2010 were documented and implemented. The contemporaneous note in the EPJS was conceded to be an incomplete record of everything that was decided on the ward round
concerns.hazard: incomplete documentation of ward round decisions

concerns.quote: other patients may come to harm if allowed to depart in-patient care without clear follow-up arrangements
concerns.hazard: departure of patients without clear follow-up arrangements

concerns.quote: important decisions are better documented and that follow-up arrangements are made clear and adequately documented
concerns.hazard: inadequate documentation of decisions and follow-up arrangements

reports.title: Gary Richards
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

promises.quote: The Trust's policy on risk assessment is clear in its documentation and staff have been reminded to ensure that when risk is assessed, that this is documented in the correct fashion in the relevant section of the electronic patient record to ensure that this is easily accessible by all clinical staff.
promises.summary: Staff reminded to document risk assessments correctly in electronic records

concerns.quote: Psychiatric staff did not properly assess his risk of self harm, nor communicate his vulnerability to others
After discharge in May, he was not followed up, as there was no address and his mobile phone number was not recorded

links.explanation: Both reports highlight that patients discharged from inpatient care were not ensured proper follow‑up due to missing or unclear arrangements. The earlier report stresses undocumented follow‑up plans, while the later report notes absent contact details preventing any follow‑up.
links.earlier_quote: My concern is about the way in which the outcome of decisions taken by the consultant on the ward round on 15 October 2010 were documented and implemented.
links.later_quote: (2) After discharge in May, he was not followed up, as there was no address and his mobile phone number was not recorded.
